question: Does support-conditioned shrinkage of the DCC-L local junction-to-bond statistic toward the existing graph-level mean-field statistic improve raw-y MAE on Fit-unseen radius-2 environments, and is any gain due to the support-to-bond correspondence rather than the support distribution?

official_test.policy: no code path in this round constructs or reads ad_test.pt; official test is not used for any selection, metric or decision

data.dataset: PyG ZINC subset=True, official train 10000 / valid 1000 / test 1000
data.split_reuse_reason: The split is an existing frozen, label-blind, canonical-SMILES grouped partition with exactly Fit8k/Monitor1k/Locked1k. It is also the split on which the two frozen DCC-L Fit8k trajectories used here were trained, so the L arm has the identical Fit set, initialisation, batch order and 47400 updates at zero additional GPU cost. Building a new split would break that exact matching and add a new structure-selection degree of freedom.

support.key: exact typed radius-2 rooted signature (k2), using the same construction as the DCC-L bottleneck audit (dcb code dca_common.radius2_signature_sets; central atom type + sorted (bond type, radius-1 signature of neighbour))
support.count_unit: document frequency over the model Fit molecules; one molecule contributes at most 1 to a signature count even if the signature occurs several times in it
support.fit_scope: the model Fit set only; Monitor, Locked, official valid and official test structures are never added to the support table
support.train_self_exclusion: leave-one-out: for a Fit molecule s = df - 1 (every signature of the molecule is present in df); for a non-Fit query s = df
support.bond_support: s_b = min(s_u, s_v) over the two endpoint atoms of the bond
support.tuning: none; the denominator, key, count unit and bond rule are frozen before any training

arms.L: alpha = 1; no bond_alpha key is passed, so the forward is the exact original DCC-L forward
arms.S: support alpha from the Fit set, leave-one-out on Fit rows
arms.P: the same per-molecule alpha values as S, permuted across the molecule's bonds by a fixed label-free salt; the per-molecule alpha multiset is exactly preserved

permutation.scope: within molecule only, independent of labels, model, batch and training order; a deterministic function of (salt, molecule row)
permutation.implementation: numpy SeedSequence([salt, row]) -> permutation of the molecule's bond-alpha vector

model.forward_change: W_local -> alpha * W_local + (1 - alpha) * W_group_to_bonds; V_local -> alpha * V_local + (1 - alpha) * V_group_to_bonds, applied per bond immediately before the local composer
model.global_statistic: the existing DCC-L group_to_bonds mean-field statistic (n_b * graph mean of junction w / w^2); it is not a new module, tensor or feature

recipe.checkpoint_selection_phase1: strict minimum of Monitor MAE every epoch; best-monitor is the primary checkpoint, final is a robustness readout
recipe.checkpoint_selection_phase2: strict minimum of official valid MAE every epoch, matching the frozen DCC-L full-10k protocol

phase1.l_source: zinc_dccl_bottleneck_v1/runs/fit8k_s{seed}/best_monitor.pt and final.pt (frozen; same Fit8k, initialisation, batch order, recipe and 47400 updates; verified in Phase 0)
phase1.primary_group: Locked rows with label_excess == 0 (no manual ring penalty; the frozen zema_audit penalty mask) and at least one atom whose k2 signature has Fit support 0 (any-unseen)

secondary_groups.locked_natural_prevalence: tier-weighted Locked MAE with fixed held-out tier weights unseen=604/2000, low4=760/2000, full=636/2000

gates.primary_rule: seed-mean delta <= -0.015 AND both seed deltas < 0, separately for S-L and S-P
gates.overall_rule: seed-mean natural-prevalence delta <= -0.003 AND both seed deltas < 0, separately for S-L and S-P
gates.ordinary_rule: max over seeds of ordinary_seen delta <= +0.002, separately for S-L and S-P
gates.paired_ci: 10k molecule bootstrap of the seed-mean per-molecule AE difference; 95% CI upper < 0 for the primary and overall contrasts
gates.seed_stability: both seed deltas strictly negative and max(seed delta) - min(seed delta) <= 0.015
gates.drop_top_k: after removing the 1 and 10 Locked primary rows with the largest |seed-mean delta AE|, the remaining seed-mean primary delta stays <= -0.010 and keeps its sign
gates.key_cluster: cluster the primary rows by the exact set of Fit-unseen k2 signatures; cluster bootstrap of the seed-mean delta keeps the sign and its 95% CI upper < 0 (274 clusters, 270 singletons, so this is nearly the molecule bootstrap)

phase1.decision_rule: PASS requires every gate for both S-L and S-P, including the safety caps. A primary mean delta in (-0.015, -0.010] with both seeds same-sign and CI < 0 is NEAR_MISS_STOP (no Phase 2, no rescue). A sign split across seeds is STOP_UNSTABLE. A significant placement effect (S-P pass) with no total effect (S-L fail), or the reverse, is STOP_MECHANISM_NOT_SUPPORTED. Any rescue by changing the alpha denominator, support key/count unit, layers, width or optimizer is forbidden.

phase2.monitor_and_confirmation: official valid 1000; official test never loaded
phase2.primary_group: official valid rows with label_excess == 0 and at least one atom whose k2 signature has full-train support 0

gates.primary_rule: seed-mean delta <= -0.010 AND both seed deltas < 0
gates.overall_rule: seed-mean official-valid tier-weighted delta <= -0.003 AND both seed deltas < 0
gates.ordinary_rule: max over seeds of official-valid ordinary_seen delta <= +0.002
gates.paired_ci: 10k molecule bootstrap of the seed-mean per-molecule AE difference; 95% CI upper < 0 for the primary and overall contrasts
gates.note: the official-valid primary has n=241, so the pre-registered Phase 2 threshold is 0.010 rather than the Phase 1 0.015; this is fixed here, before any Phase 2 result

phase2.bosil: only if Phase 2 passes; a bond-only BOSI rewrite design is then written, not implemented in this round

budget.note: L arms are frozen checkpoints and cost 0 new GPU hours; if the frozen L checkpoints cannot be verified on the remote host, the contingency is a matched L retrain (2 x ~0.37 GPU-h), which is charged to the hard cap and reported

no_rescue: do not change the alpha denominator 4
do not change the radius-2 key, document-frequency count unit or the min-of-endpoints bond rule
do not add layers, width, features, parameters, message passing or a second branch
do not change the optimizer, schedule, batch size or update count
do not add seeds beyond the two pre-registered ones
do not use official test for any purpose
do not read official valid during Phase 1
a negative or near-miss result is recorded and closes the mechanism; it is not converted into another sweep
non_claims: the mechanical route is a convex shrinkage of an existing statistic; it is not a new structural feature
the primary group is an enriched Locked subset (277/1000), not a natural-prevalence sample; the overall gate uses the fixed tier-weighted estimate
two seeds only; the paired bootstrap is molecule-level, not training-seed variance
the label-derived penalty mask is used only for evaluation grouping, never for training, support, alpha or checkpoint selection
official valid is a repeatedly used development set; Phase 2 is a development confirmation, not a pristine test
